units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ</cite> <he>נתון ע״ג מ׳</he> placed on a stationary stone bench, opp. <he>מיטה</he>, couch.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:2:5">Y. Erub. VII, 24ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>עשה מ׳ על פני וכ׳</he> (not <he>עשרה</he>) if he attached a porch along the whole front of the wall.—Pl. <he>מִסְטְוָיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 5:8:2">Y. Pes. V, 32ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מ׳ היו עושין להון</he> they made for them projecting boards (along the wall, that they should not step on the blood; Bab.
